title: Returns Desk Schedule: Restocking Charge on Duplicate and High-Value Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Gifts
content:
The registry restocking charge of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry applies the registry restocking percent according to the gift, and is deducted from the registry credit for the returned gift:

- a gift that is a duplicate, because the guest gift entries of its item outnumber the requested quantity of the item's most recent item entry (an item without an item entry counting as requesting none), carries no restocking charge;
- a gift that is not a duplicate and whose entry amount is at least the restocking taper threshold of **USD 750.00** carries the full percent on USD 750.00 plus half the percent on the part of the amount above it;
- any other gift carries the percent on its whole entry amount.

The guest gift entries counted are all guest gift entries of that item on the registry; for an item with no item entry, any guest gift entry of it outnumbers the none requested.

## Worked charges (hypothetical restocking percent of 15)

| Requested quantity | Guest gift entries of the item | Gift entry amount | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 3 | USD 400.00 | none (duplicate) |
| 2 | 2 | USD 200.00 | 15 percent of USD 200.00, USD 30.00 |
| 1 | 1 | USD 750.00 | 15 percent of USD 750.00, USD 112.50 |
| 1 | 1 | USD 1000.00 | 15 percent of USD 750.00 plus 7.5 percent of USD 250.00, USD 131.25 |

## Points of judgement

- Entries equal in number to the requested quantity are not a duplicate; only entries that outnumber it are.
- The half rate applies only to the part above USD 750.00.
